name: Derives From Source Package
description: This package is built from this source package: the apk database's origin (o:) line, a deb's Source field, an rpm's source RPM. A reference, not containment: one source package builds many binary packages and outlives any one of them. Drawn for every package, including one whose source is itself, so a join by source never needs a fallback. Binary and source share one version in the apk database. A package in an ecosystem with no binary/source split (pypi, npm) has no such edge.
